name: whale_girl
tagline: A Windows desktop chatbot that lets DeepSeek respond in WeChat groups.
description: Whale Girl is a local‑first AI companion for WeChat that runs on Windows 10 or 11. It replies to @‑mentions and its name in group chats, remembers facts from private chats, and can send stickers, voice messages, and daily diary entries. The launcher provides a single control panel and exposes a local HTTP API at 127.0.0.1:8787. Users configure a model provider such as DeepSeek, Zhipu, or any OpenAI‑compatible endpoint, and optional local servers like Ollama. The installer bundles Node.js, Python 3.12 and the .NET runtime, requiring no extra downloads.
best_for: keeping a personal AI memory of chats
sending stickers and voice replies in WeChat
generating a daily Markdown diary entry

free_tier.notes: Local‑first AI companion for WeChat, runs on Windows.
